items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Stock May Be 11% Undervalued Following Service Outlook Cut
items.summary: Fortinet has rewarded long term holders with a powerful run, yet the recent share pullback and shifting expectations for its service business leave a clear question about how well today’s valuation lines up with the cash the company can generate. With the stock now reacting sharply to any change in growth assumptions, investors are increasingly focused on what its future cash flows are really worth.
